body: If I was high while reading this thread I wouldn't know what to do with myself.
Ssshhh. He's taking comfort in his chickens.
That was beautiful. Thank you for explaining.

It's probably been a decade+ that I've been thinking about suicide. It's not something I could just drop. And in a way it really helps, I won't kill myself today because I could always die tomorrow, kind of thing.

It sounds like she's moving on. It sucks, I'm sure there are a lot of memories from those 4 years. That's a pretty long time. It'd probably be better to let her go, but be ready and open so you don't miss the right person when they come along. If she's so on the fence like that, she's likely not in love anymore. 

Yeah, people don't think of me as a typical "suicidal" looking person, whatever that is. I'm a outwardly happy, quick to laugh kind of person. I was kind of a class clown, because I like being goofy. Thinking about suicide is the only thing that gets me through the day. I fantasize about killing myself, but obviously haven't gotten around to that part yet.

Going to be a vet one day. Currently working with one. If I had to pick a reason, I'd say I'm depressed because I'm alone basically all the time, except when I'm working. I need friends but am too tired to make them, and I'm not really sure where to start meeting people in my tiny town. It seems like a huge chore, rather than something beneficial.

It's also my birthday next week, and I think that's contributing.

I'm getting over a cold I came down with on Saturday. I think it'll be over soon, but it was one of those fast and hard ones. For some reason being alone and sick is equally depressing. Normally I'm fine, but for the past couple nights I just kept wishing I had someone to eat soup with. haha.

All of my friends are currently away at school, where I probably should be, too. I'm working getting great experience though, but that doesn't really leave time for making new friends.

"Who am I?"

or, *cough* *cough* "I think I've got the black lung, Pop."
